answer: Each identity must grow a work vine costing 6 hours and $14 per fake: 40 hash-chained micro-tasks, each committed before the next is revealed, one link every 9 minutes — a steady pulse no farm can parallelize, since each chain is strictly sequential. At close, a zephyr audit replays 5 random links per vine; one broken link voids the whole identity and burns its bond. A thousand fakes need a thousand separate 6-hour chains, so bulk farming pays 6,000 hours for one epoch's reward.
